t: Mon-Sat 8 AM - 6 PM, Sun 9 AM - 1 PM

ad: 121/C, Chord Rd, near Iskcon Temple, Rajajinagar, 1st R Block, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560010
d: Flagship of Dr. Bhujang Shetty's eye hospital chain — cataract, cornea, retina, pediatric ophthalmology, and refractive surgery. Exceptional 4.9/82,000+ rating. Well-organized, affordable, strong surgical outcomes. North-west Bangalore anchor.
b: Cataract, All eye care, West Bangalore, Affordable
t: Mon-Sat 8 AM - 8 PM, Sun 8 AM - 5 PM

ad: 8, HCG Towers, P. Kalinga Rao Rd, Sampangi Rama Nagara, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560020
d: Flagship of HealthCare Global — India's largest private cancer care network. Full-spectrum oncology: medical, surgical, radiation, hemato-oncology, precision medicine. 4.7/7,700+ rating with strong reviews for consultant expertise. Also has Double Road outlet in Shanti Nagar.

ad: Dr M.H. Marigowda Rd, Lakkasandra, Hombegowda Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560029
d: Karnataka state government's dedicated cancer institute (est. 1973). Free/nominal-cost cancer care including surgery, chemotherapy, radiation, and free food/lodging for patients and attendants. Serves South India's under-resourced patients — extraordinarily high patient volume; expect 1-1.5 month waits for chemo scheduling. Clinically capable but operationally overwhelmed.
b: Under-resourced patients, Long waits acceptable, Bulk-referral

ad: 4/1, Tumkur Rd, Yeshwanthpur Industrial Area, Phase 1, Yeswanthpur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560022
d: Sparsh Group's Yeshwanthpur facility — flagship for orthopedics, trauma, joint replacement, and sports medicine. Also handles obstetrics, general surgery, physiotherapy. 4.7/17,800+ rating. West Bangalore anchor. Well-run inpatient care though room quality varies.
b: Orthopedics, Joint replacement, Sports injuries, Trauma

ad: 1st Floor, 1533, 9th Main Rd, Bairasandra Extension, Jaya Nagar 1st Block, Jayanagar 3rd Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011
d: Cloudnine's Jayanagar flagship — maternity, obstetrics, gynecology, IVF, neonatal ICU, pediatrics, lactation support. 4.7/9,000+ rating. Well-regarded for delivery and post-natal care. Note: one recent escalation review flagged hygiene concerns during a Luxury Package delivery — worth verifying with recent patients.

ad: 514/1, 2-3, Sarjapur Main Rd, opp. More Mall, Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560104
d: Motherhood chain's Sarjapur facility — maternity, obstetrics, gynecology, IVF, pediatric care. 4.6/11,000+ rating. Convenient for ORR / Sarjapur / Whitefield tech corridor. Note: some patient reviews mention perceived cost-pressure and doctor turnover — get a second opinion before large-package commitments.

ad: 869, Kade Complex, Modi Eye Hospital Road, Chord Rd, Stage 2, Basaveshwar Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560086
d: Fertility specialty clinic — IVF, IUI, ICSI, egg freezing, myomectomy. 4.9/1,200+ rating with strong outcome reviews (multiple mentions of successful conceptions post low-AMH and miscarriage cases). West Bangalore.

ad: 1st Cross, Shankarapuram, Basavanagudi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560004
d: Not-for-profit trust hospital in central-south Bangalore — general medicine, vascular surgery, pediatrics, orthopedics. 3.8/1,500 rating with mixed reviews. Historically important, affordable. Recent reviews flag hygiene concerns (canteen proximity to waste-handling areas) and an outdated policy of not letting spouses accompany patients in OB consultation — worth being aware of.
b: Affordable general care, South Bangalore, Trust-run

ad: Nandi Hills Viewpoint, Nandi Hills, Karnataka 562103 (destination)
d: Bangalore's iconic cycling climb. ~55-65 km one way from central Bangalore (Hebbal/Yelahanka start), with the last 8 km being a demanding 1,400m elevation gain up to the top. Serious cyclists ride it as a Saturday/Sunday sunrise attempt — leave city by 3:30 AM to catch sunrise at the top. Traffic is minimal pre-dawn; steeper on weekends. Gate opens at ~6 AM.

ad: Chikkaballapur, Karnataka 562101 (loop destination)
d: Longer variant of the Nandi route for those skipping the climb — ~55 km one way to Chikkaballapur town via the smooth Bangalore-Hyderabad highway service roads. Rolling terrain, less traffic than main highway. Good for endurance training.

ad: Dodda Aalada Mara, Dodda Aladmara Rd, Kethohalli, Karnataka 562130 (destination)
d: Classic ~28-30 km southwest ride from central Bangalore via Mysore Road / Kumbalgodu. Route reaches a 400-year-old sprawling banyan tree — good coffee/breakfast options nearby (Manchinbele/Ramohalli). Mostly flat, family-friendly, one of the first 'proper' rides for beginners.

ad: Turahalli Forest, 100 Feet Rd, Thurahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560109
d: South Bangalore's mountain biking hub — eucalyptus forest with technical off-road trails. ~15-20 km from Jayanagar. Popular with the MTB community, weekend group rides. Trails vary from beginner-friendly to technical singletrack. Best in dry weather; monsoon turns trails to slush.

ad: Hesaraghatta Lake, Hesaraghatta, Karnataka 560088 (destination)
d: Northwest lake ride, ~35-40 km round trip from central Bangalore. Scenic roads through Nelamangala/Sondekoppa. Lake is fenced off (no swimming) but the ride and the adjacent grasslands (birdwatching) make it a favorite Sunday route. Mostly flat, low-traffic on early mornings.

ad: Devanahalli Fort, Devanahalli, Karnataka 562110 (destination)
d: Northeast ride to Tipu Sultan's birthplace, ~35-40 km one way from central Bangalore via the airport road corridor. Long-standing weekend route, mostly flat, well-paved. Best early morning before airport traffic builds up. Fort has ruins to explore before heading back.

ad: Ramadevara Betta, Thimmegowdanadoddi, Ramanagara, Karnataka 562128 (destination)
d: Southwest ride, ~50 km one way via Mysore Road, ending at the Ramadevara Betta vulture sanctuary (Sholay filming location). Can be combined with the ~380-step climb to the Pattabhi Rama temple at the top. Popular with cyclists doing bike-and-hike combos.

ad: Manchanabele Dam, SH 85, Manchanabele, Karnataka 562128 (destination)
d: Southwest ~40 km ride via Magadi Road ending at the scenic Manchanabele reservoir. Rolling terrain, sunset views back toward Savandurga. Note: dam access is restricted (only viewable from road/watchtower); police block sunset points on some Sundays. Ride is worthwhile even without dam access.

ad: Kaggalipura-Bannerghatta forest checkpost, Kaggalipura Rd, Bhoothanahalli, Karnataka 560083
d: South Bangalore forest-road cycling route through Bannerghatta National Park boundary — narrow forest road with wildlife sightings possible (occasional elephants). Karnataka Forest Department territory: stopping restricted, speed limits enforced, wild-animal warnings throughout. Cycling and driving allowed; safest before/after peak hours.
t: Daytime only (9 AM - 4 PM checkpost hours)

ad: Antaragange Cave, Paparajanahalli, Karnataka 563101 (destination)
d: Advanced ~70 km one-way ride east to Kolar's cave-hill region. Combines a serious road ride with an optional cave-trek at the destination. Book cave permits via MyEcoTrip portal (govt required as of March 2026). Ride is for experienced endurance cyclists — not beginner-friendly.

ad: Bagalur Bamboo Forest, Mitganahalli, Karnataka 562149 (destination)
d: Hidden-gem bamboo grove ~30 km northeast of central Bangalore via Hennur Road. Route rated 3/5 by local riders (traffic on Hennur Road), the destination itself 5/5. Seasonal color changes in the bamboo, peacock sightings possible, tranquil lake at the edge. Cycling inside is sometimes permitted. Also hosts an annual Marathon Run. No food nearby — pack your own.
b: Weekend riders, Nature photography, Sunrise chasers

ad: Avalahalli State Forest, Jarakabande Kaval, Karnataka 560119
d: Best forest-trail cycling around Bangalore per local riders — 7.5 km outer perimeter plus a 3-4 km inner forest loop through eucalyptus and native vegetation. MTB or hybrid preferred but road bikes manage (some carrying required). Multiple lakes and viewpoints inside. ₹10 entry, cash only. Also called 'Oxygen Park' by locals. Access via Presidency School side.
b: MTB riders, Weekend riders, Trail runners

ad: Chokkanahalli Forest, Maralakunte, Marasandra, Karnataka 562165
d: 855-acre KFD-managed reserve directly opposite the Bagalur/Hennur Bamboo Forest. Natural jungle feel with bamboo plantations, trails good for cycling and walking. Watchtower on a small hill inside. Hosts the annual Bangalore Ultra Marathon in November. Note: forest department permission may be required for deeper access; verify at the gate.

ad: KMF Cattle Feed Plant reference point, Addhiganahalli, Karnataka 560119
d: The scenic long-way approach to Hesaraghatta Lake — via Rajanukunte town and the KMF (Karnataka Milk Federation) cattle-feed plant. Team-BHP riders rate the KMF-to-Hesaraghatta stretch as one of the best roads in the region for cycling. Longer than the standard route (via Avalahalli) — for endurance riders who want the picturesque road, not just the destination.

ad: Kempegowda International Airport, Devanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560300 (destination)
d: The airport opened its premises to cyclists on Sundays during the pandemic — smooth, wide, low-traffic roads make it a unique civic cycling infrastructure. Secure cycle parking has been reported. Reachable via a magnificent flyover from the Bengaluru-Hyderabad highway. Verify current Sunday-cycling policy before you go — this arrangement has been intermittent.

ad: Bhartiya City, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064
d: North Bangalore's mixed-use township — residential precinct plus retail/mall — designed with generous greenery, ponds, and wide boulevards. Excellent for a quiet, safe, canopy-covered ride without leaving the city. Neither a foliage forest like Cubbon nor a highway route. Good option for beginners nervous about traffic.

ad: Pyramid Valley International, Kanakapura Main Rd, Harohalli, Karnataka 562112 (reference destination ~35km out)
d: Long professional cycling corridor — the full route to Kanakapura town is ~104 km round trip, with lower traffic than most Bangalore arterials once you clear Bannerghatta junction. Popular training route for serious cyclists. Common turnaround points include Pyramid Valley (~35 km) and Kaggalipura. Best pre-dawn to early morning.

ad: Thattekere Lake Viewpoint, Harohalli, Thattekere, Karnataka 562112
d: Small serene lake tucked off Kanakapura Road via Harohalli. Popular short escape from the Kanakapura corridor. IMPORTANT SAFETY NOTE: local reviews and forest signage report crocodiles in the lake water and occasional elephant visits — the lake is in a sensitive protected forest area. Do NOT approach the water or step past barricades. Cyclists should stay on the road, take pictures from the viewpoint only. Closed Sundays.

ad: Narayanakere Lake, Narayanakere, Karnataka 560117
d: Peaceful lake east of the city, ~30 km via Sarjapur–Marathahalli Road. Panoramic route through agricultural land and small villages — a quieter alternative to the tech-corridor grind. Scenic ride reported by cyclists. Route may vary; multiple approaches from Sarjapur.

n: Race Course Rd + Bhavan Rd Cycling Lanes
ad: Race Course Rd, Racecourse, Gandhi Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001
d: Central Bangalore's dedicated cycling infrastructure — green cycling lanes running along Race Course Road and Bhavan Road, connecting to Cubbon Park. Tree-canopied throughout, one of the best urban cycling stretches in the city. Great for a short casual ride or as a warm-up to a Cubbon Park loop.
b: Casual cyclists, Commuters, Short rides, Beginners

ad: Green Avenue, Plot 1, ITPL Main Rd, EPIP Zone, Brookefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560037
d: Cult favourite South Indian cafe with temple-inspired decor. Ghee podi idli, open butter masala dosa, filter coffee. Expect long queues and crowds — 5 AM to 1 AM. Also has outlets in Kalyan Nagar, Bellandur, ORR.

ad: 7th Cross Rd, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003
d: Legendary Malleshwaram tiffin room, world-famous for its benne (butter) masala dosa. 70s-era ambience with a two-storey seating plus AC hall. Iconic Bangalore breakfast experience. Expect 30-minute queues on weekends. Serves 7-12:30 AM & 4-9:30 PM.

ad: 32, Gandhi Bazaar Main Rd, Gandhi Bazaar, Basavanagudi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560004
d: Since 1943 — the iconic South Bangalore dosa institution. Token-based queue system, hour-long waits, shared tables (part of the charm). Ghee-drenched masala dosa, khara bath, kesari bath, filter coffee. CLOSED FRIDAYS. Note: cash-forward, no reservations.
b: Iconic dosa experience, Heritage, Basavanagudi visits

ad: 14, Lal Bagh Main Rd, Doddamavalli, Sudhama Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560027
d: Over 100 years old. Invented the rava idli. Iconic Bangalore breakfast — masala dosa, rava idli, bisibele bath served in traditional silver tumblers. Heritage vibe. Note: CLOSED MONDAYS. Also runs a global packaged-foods business.
b: Heritage breakfast, Rava idli origin story

ad: 45/3, GK Complex, Residency Rd 1st Cross, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025
d: Legendary Bangalore dessert institution — the Death By Chocolate (DBC) is iconic. Also try the Hot Caramelo Pudding and the Trilogy sundae. Multiple outlets city-wide; Residency Road is the flagship. 11 AM - 11 PM daily.

ad: 42, Ramamurthi Nagar Main Rd, near Axis Bank, Krishna Reddy Layout, Ramamurthy Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560016
d: The Mangalore-original ice cream brand, cult-favourite for Sitaphal (custard apple) and Paan flavours. Available only via distributors in Bangalore — this outlet also sells Mangalore snacks (kori rotti, appe midi pickle, patrado). Small, unpretentious, authentic.

ad: 690, 12th Cross Rd, 7th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560070
d: National chain famous for real-fruit flavours — tender coconut, jackfruit, papaya, sitaphal. Jayanagar outlet is a South Bangalore staple. Open till 1 AM.
b: Fruit-based ice cream, Late-night dessert, Family

ad: 297, 100 Feet Rd, near Toit Pub, 2nd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038
d: Bangalore's most-loved bakehouse — cheesecakes, red velvet cupcakes, tiramisu, croissants, mutton puffs, sourdough pizza. Rustic-cozy vibe. Open till 12:30 AM. Also outlets in Koramangala and elsewhere. Right next to Toit.

ad: ITC Gardenia, opposite Ramana Hotel, 1, Residency Rd, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025
d: ITC's luxury chocolate lounge inside the ITC Gardenia. Hand-crafted single-origin bean-to-bar chocolates, ruby cocoa creations, praline range, hot chocolate. Boutique presentation, Disneyland-for-chocolate vibe. Splurge experience.

ad: Taj Vivanta, 66, Residency Rd, Srinivas Nagar, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025
d: Taj Vivanta's award-winning coastal restaurant — Mangalorean, Kerala, Konkan cuisine. Kori Ghee Roast, Meen Pollichathu, Neer Dosa. Rustic-tropical ambience. Note: some recent reviews (Apr 2026) mention service inconsistency; still generally strong reputation. Best for special occasions.
b: Special occasions, Coastal cuisine, Fine dining

ad: 39, St Mark's Rd, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001
d: Heritage restaurant since 1940 — a Bangalore institution and pilgrimage site for old-school character. Continental + Anglo-Indian menu, mutton cutlets, parathas, filter coffee. Vintage furniture, no AC in some sections, sometimes gruff service. Divisive: some love the nostalgia, some find it dated. Central St. Mark's Road.

ad: 6/2, 100 Feet Rd, near Drops Total Spirites, Binnamangala, Stage 1, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038
d: Bangalore's most-loved brewpub — award-winning craft beers (Hefeweizen, IPA), wood-fired pizzas, generous portions. Rustic industrial vibe. Weekends are packed (pre-book strongly recommended). Also serves a solid weekend brunch.
b: Craft beer, Group hangouts, Brunch, Pizza

ad: 46, Millers Rd, Kaverappa Layout, Vasanth Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001
d: Cowboy-saloon themed steakhouse — reputation for the best steaks in Bangalore. Ribeye, Big Boy T-Bone, Tequila Tabasco steak. Also serves burgers, pork, chicken, fish, mutton. Complimentary bread + herb butter. Prices ₹850-1500 for mains. Book ahead — parking is tough.
b: Steak lovers, Special occasions, Non-veg indulgence

ad: 57/1, Jayalakshmi Chambers, Residency Rd, next to Old Galaxy Theatre, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025
d: Bangalore's most-hyped Andhra biryani chain. Meghana Special Chicken Biryani, boneless variant, 555 chicken. Portion sizes generous (biryani easily feeds two). Multiple outlets city-wide; Residency Road is one of the busiest. Late night till 1 AM.
b: Biryani, Andhra spice, Late night, Group meal

ad: 36, Church St, opposite Sobha Mall, off M.G. Road, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001
d: Iconic late-night Bangalore joint. Butter naan, kadai chicken, ghee rice, tandoori. Open till 2 AM — the go-to spot for post-clubbing biryani and butter chicken. Multiple outlets city-wide. Central Church Street is the classic experience.
b: Late-night eats, Post-drinks food, Group meal, Chicken
